plugins.name: cmux-workflow
plugins.description: Run parallel coding agents as cmux panes and actually know when they finish. Dispatch codex/grok lanes with briefs that survive, watch them via cmux's own turn-hook session store (`agentLifecycle: idle` — a recorded fact, not a `pgrep` guess), audit lanes you forgot to watch, and clean them up safely. Ships `/cmux-workflow:lanes` plus `lane-status.sh` and `lane-watch.sh`.
